turns.speaker: agent
turns.name: Halberd
turns.text: Hi, this is Halberd, the automated verification line for the School District's business office. Is this Priya Nair at Greenfield Food Service?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.name: Halberd
turns.text: Thanks, Priya. An email from your address asked us to move Greenfield's payments to Coastline Credit Union. Did you send that request?

turns.speaker: vendor
turns.name: Priya Nair
turns.text: No, I didn't send that. We haven't touched our banking in years.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.name: Halberd
turns.text: Thank you. We've kept your payments going to the account on file. You may want to have someone check your email account.
